title: invoke `input` reaches a child machine via a `context` FACTORY, and is exposed as context['input'] when the child declares a plain dict
spec: XState v5: `input` is resolved per spawn against {context, event}. This library deliberately does NOT let input overwrite declared context keys (base_interpreter.py:530, review F11 injection guard); the supported form is a context factory of {input}.
